results.description:

A greater number of seeds per pod typically leads to smaller seed size at maturity. Kabuli chickpea usually matures in 110 to 120 days. Desi type will mature somewhat earlier. [...] Chickpea germinates similar to dry pea with the seed coat and cotyledons remaining below ground (hypogeal germination). Developing plants will have 1-2 scale nodes on the stem just below the soil surface. These nodes serve as points of regrowth if the seedling is damaged (a late frost for example). On average, a new node (leaf) is produced every 3 to 4 days.

### Yield potential and markets [...] Chickpea has a low shattering potential, especially compared to dry pea and lentil. Pod drop and pod shattering can occur once seeds have dried down and are ready for harvest. Direct cutting without desiccation usually results in higher yields and larger seed size.
